requires.surfaceAlignment: Silt-bearing world direction compared with trusted boundary surface normal

attachment.acquire: near trusted boundary + Silt membrane + sufficient directional alignment
attachment.motion: velocity projected tangent to trusted membrane; position settles on inner shell
attachment.release: deliberate input away from surface or chemistry/surface loss

acceptance: Silt on the aligned membrane side produces free -> brush -> attach -> tangent traverse -> pull-away release -> free on the existing authored boundary; moving Silt away from membrane or to a poorly aligned side weakens/removes attachment.
